item.tib: mkha' 'gro rgya mtsho'i yang snying bcud / mkha' spyod gang chen rol pa yin / mkha' 'gro zab lam sde lnga'i gzungs / mkha' dbyings bde chen brgyud thob
item.note: final text in this section found by kun-grol grags-pa (o-rgyan 'ja'-tshon snying-po), then given to zhu rnam-rgyal grags-pa sangs-rgyas rin-chen dpal bzang-po, and then transmitted to zhu tshul-khrims grags-pa.
